# Chimera II cross-language implementation

The public Chimera II ecosystem uses Python for reference research/ML/RL, Node.js for web/integration, Java for Koronos/JVM semantics and C++ for native kernel/ISA/desktop implementation. Deterministic JSON/JSONL contracts, public/synthetic vectors and provenance metadata provide the interoperability boundary.

C8192/R8192 telemetry is a semantic research interface; language parity does not imply identical host performance or physical silicon.
